title: velvety sour norwegian oats gratin
description: a lazy-sunday norwegian dish featuring oats and render-fat. can be adjusted to suit raw-friendly diets.

ingredients.name: apple cider vinegar
ingredients.notes: raw-friendly substitute for traditional sour cream

instructions: preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit and place a cedar plank on a baking sheet.
rinse the oats in cold water and soak them for at least 30 minutes.
drain the oats and mix them with the rendered fat, water, apple cider vinegar, salt, black pepper, and fresh parsley.
pour the oat mixture onto the preheated cedar plank and smooth the top.
cover the baking sheet with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes or until the oats are tender.
if serving with yogurt or coconut yogurt, top the oats with it before serving.
garnish with chopped scallions before serving.
